name: Screen recorder (mouse + keys, cursor replay, cues)
description: Records what a person does over a stage (a page in a frame, or any element): pointer moves, clicks, scrolls, keys, page changes and markers, with times and positions as fractions of the stage; optionally the screen as video (the browser's screen-share prompt, kept on the device). Replays a recording as an animated cursor with click ripples and key captions, and turns events into a cue track (move, click, type, key, scroll, wait, highlight, open page). Harvested Oct 22 2026 from Walkthrough Studio's live browser.

parts.label: Capture layer
parts.description: A transparent layer over the stage records every move and click anywhere (the page under it doesn't get them).

parts.label: Same-site page events
parts.description: When the framed page is from this site, its own clicks and keys are recorded while you use it.

parts.label: Keys
parts.description: Keys pressed while recording (typed text becomes one cue).

parts.label: Screen video
parts.description: Also record the screen (getDisplayMedia + MediaRecorder); the video stays on the device.

parts.label: Cursor replay
parts.description: Play a recording back as an animated cursor.

parts.label: Events → cue track
parts.description: Turn a recording into cues (move, click, type, key, scroll, wait, highlight, open page).

placeholders.note: Android port (MediaProjection + accessibility events) — Android on hold.
Microphone narration while recording — not built.
